title: [Script Conflict Issue] Fullscreen++ with Wiggly Text

posts.author: xxforgotten
posts.body:
Hello, I'm a newbie when it comes to coding and scripts so please bear with me.I am running into an issue when running a game with both the
Fullscreen ++ Script
by Zeus81 and
Tuckie's Wiggly Text script
.
When running both scripts, the text that is written in the text boxes becomes distorted. This only affects the text in the text boxes, not menu text, or inventory text, or save data window text.
Normal Default appearance
When both scripts are active
I have seen other threads with the script causing the letters to shrink, but this seems to be the opposite and causes the letters to get wider.
I believe this has something to do with this part of Wiggly Text Script:
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------  # * Normal Character Processing | Overwrite  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------  def process_normal_character(c, pos)    if @anim_type && @anim_type > 0      process_anim_character(c, pos)      else      if WiggleText:
ROP_IN        @anim_type = 7        process_anim_character(c, pos)      else        super      end    end    wait_for_one_character  end  #------------
Click to expand...
But I can't figure out why. I dug around and found that when I comment out
process_anim_character(c, pos)
(line number 199-201) in the wiggly text script, the text displays how it's supposed to but the wiggly text stops working. I've tried shuffling the script load order but that didn't make a difference. I need the wiggly text script, but I'd like to use the fullscreen++ script too.If anyone can help, I would really appreciate it. I have attached a demo project that has the three (Zeus Module, Fullscreen++, Wiggly Text) scripts and a talking event all set up.
Thank you!

posts.author: Roninator2
posts.body:
Lines 216 - 219 you can either remove them and it will work fine, or you can change the number in there.
Default is 0.6 for the old full screen script. works fine by my eye at 0.01

posts.author: xxforgotten
posts.body: You're amazing, thank you! It worked! Thread can be closed.
